title: •Forced Servitude
caption: •Forced Servitude (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your troopers are Heroic. Opponent’s total weapon destiny targeting your Heroic cards is +2. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). {alter}
lore: The Empire often uses droids for nefarious purposes. Imperials compel droids to do jobs that are repugnant to humans. An automaton has no ethical conscience.
